title: Concept: NuGet lockfile recorded a floating version
description: packages.lock.json declares a resolved version that is a floating `N.*` selector, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A floating version resolves to whatever exists at restore time, so the lockfile stops describing the tree that was reviewed.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.lock.json (nuget).
risk: A floating version resolves to whatever exists at restore time, so the lockfile stops describing the tree that was reviewed.
